rows.title: Kanopy's price from the offer book
rows.test: the line cites the term's source and checked date

rows.title: The gap is charge minus the book's price
rows.test: a $2.99 term makes a $15.99 charge a $13.00 gap

rows.title: A stale term is said
rows.test: a term past its window says it may have changed

rows.title: Paid streaming now
rows.defect: any past charge counts as paid now
rows.test: a June Peacock charge is not listed

rows.title: A refund is not a charge
rows.test: a refund-only Netflix row is not paid streaming

rows.title: Dollars only
rows.test: a euro charge is not a dollar charge

rows.title: A plan's perk is not a library ask
rows.defect: the perk words are not excluded
rows.test: T-Mobile and Walmart+ perk asks go to the savings answer

rows.title: Billed every month
rows.defect: any two charges read as monthly
rows.test: charges two months apart are not 'a month'

rows.title: Hoopla is not on file
rows.test: a Hoopla ask says it isn't on file

rows.title: No rows, no number
rows.defect: an empty feed goes on to the charge search
rows.test: no linked rows says no card yet

rows.title: Coupons and totals are not items
rows.defect: coupon, total and tax lines are read as items
rows.test: a Tide coupon line is not a Tide price

rows.title: Medicine: the active ingredient
rows.test: Advil says to match the active ingredient

rows.title: No invented store-brand price
rows.defect: a remembered 30% replaces the shelf tag
rows.test: the shelf tag line, and no percent

rows.title: Every receipt price for a brand
rows.defect: only the first price is shown
rows.test: two Tide lines show both prices

rows.title: Prescriptions are not grocery swaps
rows.defect: the prescription words are not excluded
rows.test: a prescription's generic is not a store-brand ask
